gloss: message board; notice board; communication board

definitions.gloss: message board; notice board; communication board
definitions.explanation: A physical or digital board used to post messages, announcements, and notices for a group. Common in schools, workplaces, and community settings.

examples.japanese: {連絡板|れんらくばん}に{予定|よてい}を{書|か}いておいた。
examples.english: I wrote the schedule on the message board.

examples.japanese: {大事|だいじ}なお{知|し}らせが{連絡板|れんらくばん}に{貼|は}ってある。
examples.english: An important notice is posted on the message board.

examples.japanese: {社内|しゃない}の{連絡板|れんらくばん}を{毎日|まいにち}{確認|かくにん}するのが{習慣|しゅうかん}になっている。
examples.english: It has become a habit to check the company message board every day.

notes:
A compound of {連絡|れんらく} (communication, contact) and {板|ばん} (board). Can refer to a physical bulletin board or an online message board. In Japanese schools, information is often communicated to parents through a {連絡|れんらく}{帳|ちょう} (communication notebook) rather than a board.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連絡板|れんらくばん}に{書|か}く: to write on the message board
- {連絡板|れんらくばん}を{確認|かくにん}する: to check the message board
- {連絡板|れんらくばん}に{貼|は}る: to post on the message board
- {社内|しゃない}{連絡板|れんらくばん}: company notice board

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {掲示板|けいじばん}: bulletin board — a more general term that also refers to internet forums
- {伝言板|でんごんばん}: message board (for personal messages) — a board for leaving individual messages for specific people
- {連絡帳|れんらくちょう}: communication notebook — a school notebook for messages between teachers and parents
